rules: These 50 are editorially featured model families, NOT a measured popularity ranking.
Do not treat family slugs as exact pull tags. Resolve exact verified tag and availability from the catalog on the target host.
Determine actual fit per machine and M1-M6 tier from 8-Ball-derived hardware facts, verified model metadata and versioned policy.
Target up to 50 compatible model variants per resolved tier; never pad results with incompatible or unverified model claims.
Local and cloud models are different modes; cloud-only models require connectivity and are not local weights.
Embeddings do not offer normal chat; apply type-aware actions.
Missing provenance or uncertain hardware fit must display as unknown, never as compatible.
No model pull, run, remove or inference happens during catalog/menu build.
